name: claude-code
description: Use Claude Code from Codex for second opinions, reviews, and delegated implementation tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Call a local Claude Code CLI from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Lets Codex hand a review, investigation, or implementation task to a locally installed Claude Code CLI, then bring the result back into the current Codex session.
